blocks.title: Keep early scripts from blocking HTML

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `defer` applies to an external classic script: downloading can overlap HTML parsing, and execution waits until parsing finishes.

blocks.text: The browser fetches club.js without stopping HTML parsing at this tag. It executes after the document is parsed.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a real external script file. defer does not have this effect on an inline classic script.
